messages.text:
Hi! So when someone is offboarded, Google archives their data. During the offboarding process, there's an option to transfer all the data to their manager or someone else. Beyond that, there's no sitting files/folders in the workspace that can be accessed.

If that transfer happened, then the files would simply show up under the transferee's google drive.
